references.text: The angel tells the women at the tomb that Jesus is not there but has risen, just as in Mark 16:6.

The angel reminds the women at the tomb that while Jesus was still in Galilee he told them he must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, be crucified and rise again on the third day, paralleling the message in Mark 16:6.
Mary Magdalene runs and tells Peter and another disciple that the Lord's body has been taken from the tomb, indicating that the tomb is empty, as in Mark 16:6.
The prophecy that God will raise up Israel on the third day, which can be seen as a prediction of Jesus' resurrection mentioned in Mark 16:6.
